set.body: PLS Neuro Compare Focus minimizes the lower plot group, but a sliver of plot content remains visible outside its header strip. GroupView.update never hides its content host for vertical minimization, and oversized children can overflow its zero-height area. Reproduce visible ancestry/content rendering for vertical and horizontal minimized groups, preserve pane node identity and exact restoration. User-facing evidence /private/tmp/plsneuro-brain-modes-2/compare-focus.png; consumer plsneuro bd-01M1Y8ANBY8P81GMXSFAB4QN4B.
set.title: Suppress content rendering and input in minimized groups
